summary.story: Cat connects to Diana (mythology) because the Roman goddess Diana was associated with cats and sometimes depicted alongside them. As a moon goddess, Diana leads naturally to Lunar phase, the cycle of changing moonlight from new moon to full moon and back. Those changing faces belong to the Moon, Earth’s natural satellite and the endpoint of this celestial trail.

events.summary: The cat (Felis catus), also called domestic cat and house cat, is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal. It is a member of Felidae, the family of mammals in the order Carnivora also colloquially referred to as cats.

events.summary: A lunar phase or Moon phase is the apparent shape of the Moon's day and night phases of the lunar day as viewed from Earth. Because the Moon is tidally locked to Earth, the cycle of phases takes one lunar month and moves across the same side of the Moon, which always faces Earth.
